integrity: The proof is deductive. It uses Sarkar's descent argument for automorphisms of point blow-ups in dimension at least three, the standard affine decomposition of automorphisms of an abelian variety, and countability of its group automorphisms. No computational experiment is promoted to an infinite statement.
limitations: The theorem is over the complex numbers and is stated for abelian varieties of dimension at least three.
The triple is very general, not merely general; special triples may have nontrivial stabilizers.
title: Three very general points sharply kill automorphisms of higher-dimensional abelian blow-ups
